questions.question: For the user No.24, how many times is the number of his/her posts compared to his/her votes?
questions.evidence: user no. 24 refers to UserId = OwnerUserId = '24'; times of his/her post than votes = Divide (Count(post.Id), Count(votes.Id))
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24

questions.question: Name the user that commented 'thank you user93!'
questions.evidence: "thank you user93" is the Text of comment; user refers to DisplayName
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Text = 'thank you user93!'

questions.question: From which post is the tag "bayesian" excerpted from? Please give the body of the post.
questions.evidence: "bayesian" is the TagName; excerpt from refers to ExcerptPostId
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Body FROM tags AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T2.Id = T1.ExcerptPostId WHERE T1.TagName = 'bayesian'

questions.question: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
questions.evidence: creating more than 10 post refers to Count (UserId) > 10; average of the up votes = Divide (Sum(UpVotes), Count (UserId)); average age = Divide (Sum(Age), Count(UserId))
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.UpVotes), AVG(T1.Age) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING post_count > 10) AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId

questions.question: Calculate the average view count of each post tagged as 'humor' and list the title and the comment of each post.
questions.evidence: tagged as  'humor' refers to tag = '<humor>'; comment of the post refers to Text; average view count = AVG(ViewCount)
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T2.ViewCount), T2.Title, T1.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T2.Id = T1.PostId  WHERE T2.Tags = '<humor>' GROUP BY T2.Title, T1.Text

questions.question: What is the display name of the user who last edited the post "Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation"?
questions.evidence: "Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation" is the Title of post; user who last edited refers to LastEditorUserId
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.LastEditorUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'

questions.question: For the user with the display name of "Tiago Pasqualini", how many posts did he/she own?
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini'

questions.question: State all the tags used by Mark Meckes in his posts that doesn't have comments.
questions.evidence: used by Mark Meckes refers to DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'; Doen't have comments refers to CommentCount = 0;
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.Tags FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND T3.CommentCount = 0

questions.question: Which is the most valuable post in 2010? Please give its id and the owner's display name.
questions.evidence: the most valuable post in 2010 refers to MAX(FavoriteCount) where year(CreationDate) = 2010;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.OwnerUserId, T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2010' ORDER BY T2.FavoriteCount DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many users last accessed the website after 2014/9/1?
questions.evidence: last accessed after 2014/9/1 refers to LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM users WHERE date(LastAccessDate) > '2014-09-01'

questions.question: Please list the display names of all the users whose accounts were created in the year 2011.
questions.evidence: account created in the year 2011 refers to year(CreationDate) = 2011
questions.SQL: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011'

questions.question: Among the posts with views ranging from 100 to 150, what is the comment with the highest score?
questions.evidence: views ranging from 100 to 150 refers to ViewCount BETWEEN 100 and 150; comment with the highest score refers to Text where MAX(Score);
questions.SQL: SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE PostId IN ( SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150 ) ORDER BY Score DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Write the contents of comments with a score of 17.
questions.evidence: score of 17 refers to Score = 17; contents of comments refers to Text
questions.SQL: SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

questions.question: What is the average monthly number of links created in 2010 for posts that have no more than 2 answers?
questions.evidence: calculation = DIVIDE(COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2010 and AnswerCount < = 2), 12)
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.Id) AS REAL) / 12 FROM postLinks AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.AnswerCount <= 2 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2010'

questions.question: Which post by Harvey Motulsky has the most views? Please give the id and title of this post.
questions.evidence: DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'; the most views refer to MAX(ViewCount);
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Id, T2.Title FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' ORDER BY T2.ViewCount DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: In posts with 1 comment, how many of the comments have 0 score?
questions.evidence: in posts with 1 comment refers to CommentCount = 1;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.CommentCount = 1 AND T2.Score = 0

questions.question: What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2011?
questions.evidence: student badges refers to badge's name = 'Student'; during 2010 refers to Year(Date) = 2010; during 2011 refers to Year(Date) = 2011; percentage difference = Subtract (Divide(Count(Name where Year(Date) = 2010), Count (Name)) *100, Divide(Count(Name where Year(Date) = 2011), Count(Name)) * 100)
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2010', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Id) - CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2011', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Student'
